use_case_name: Initialize a Newly Online Control Unit

claims.content: To identify a newly online control unit and all its associated device sensors, and initialize the control unit and device sensors as they are identified.

goal.raw_text: To identify a newly online control unit and all its associated device sensors, and initialize the control unit and device sensors as they are identified.

claims.content: Control Unit
The control unit is a workstation or intelligent controller at the FCU or DCU.
The RLCS software in the field has started.
Device Sensor Initialization Data is received from Data Processing and Security 3.2.4.
The MD5 algorithm resides in all the controllers and the application server.
Each workstation and control unit (workstation or intelligent controller at the FCU or DCU) comes online.

trigger.raw_text: Each workstation and control unit (workstation or intelligent controller at the FCU or DCU) comes online.

claims.content: When each workstation and control unit (workstation or intelligent controller at the FCU or DCU) comes online, the system shall identify it and all its associated device sensors.
The RLCS software shall initialize each control unit and device sensor as it is identified.
The RLCS software in the field shall first identify the its unit when it starts, by reading the cabinet id.
The RLCS software will then proceed to make sure that all the cards required in that unit are present and working properly.
The RLCS software will do a control system integrity check ( see requirement 3.0.9) and initialize all the specified tables.

Track and log all Failed Requests for Device Status and Control: If a status from any device is not received upon request, the system shall automatically request the status again; failure to receive a valid status after a configurable number of retries shall be considered a device failure.

The Message Digest value verification results shall will be recorded in the system log; a verification failure shall will cause an alarm condition for the affected control unit; if the failure occurs in checking the non-volatile memory items, the system shall will prevent the affected unit from being used in control sequences.

If a status from any device is not received upon request, the system shall automatically request the status again; failure to receive a valid status after a configurable number of retries shall be considered a device failure (exit: device failure).

A verification failure shall will cause an alarm condition for the affected control unit; if the failure occurs in checking the non-volatile memory items, the system shall will prevent the affected unit from being used in control sequences (exit: alarm condition and prevention from control sequences).
The system has identified the control unit and all its associated device sensors.
The RLCS software has initialized each control unit and device sensor as it is identified.
The RLCS software in the field has identified its unit by reading the cabinet id.
All the cards required in that unit are present and working properly.
The control system integrity check has been done and all the specified tables have been initialized.
The startup process did not exceed 30 seconds.
